description: This file defines the `CommandHeaderInvalidException` class, which is an exception thrown when a header in a command's headers is invalid. It includes methods for constructing instances from messages or JSON, as well as a builder class for flexible instantiation.

classes.name: CommandHeaderInvalidException
classes.description: An exception indicating an invalid header in a command, extending DittoRuntimeException.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for constructing the exception.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
